evidence: All five dimension prompts (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) open with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000' and inject the same tests/app_context.md, which describes this app only: 'a local JavaScript and HTML code playground: a custom code editor, a preview, a console and a shared library of saved snippets with revision history' (app_context.md:6). Credentials: 'Accounts: None. The app has no sign-in' (app_context.md:10) matches instruction.md 'without signing in' and policy.md 'without sign-in or private accounts'; the template's sign-in gate text ('if the application has sign-in, that the accounts under Accounts can sign in') was replaced in every scored prompt by an editor-typing gate (functional/polish/visual prompt.md:5). Screens: 'One workspace at /' with title/filename fields, Undo, Redo, Format, Find, Replace, line/column readout, Run, Stop, New, Save, preview, console, library and history (app_context.md:14) matches ui.md:17 and editing notes, and the golden carries those controls (custom-editor.js 'Find in code', 'Replacement text'; app.tsx 'Saved snippets', 'Revision history'). Entities: snippet with title, .js/.html filename, exact source, revisions, history - consistent across criteria and with overview.md:3 and behaviour.md:9-13. Deliverable/runtime: port 3000, /api/health (app_context.md:26 vs integration.md:3), restart only via verifier restart_app in the single criterion that names it (functional prompt.md:33; cw_save_reload_restart; verifier MCP server present only in functional judge.toml:14-18; polish/visual/gate prompts say 'Never restart the app'). Cross-prompt consistency: the 'three uses' of state-changing script in app_context.md:28 (storage clearing, recorded-request replay, one localStorage entry) each map to an existing criterion (cw_shared_saved_record/cw_save_reload_restart, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, cw_preview_isolation); constraints prompt.md:5 narrows to the storage clearing it needs; functional prompt.md:22 cites the same three uses; the 'public https address' note (app_context.md:26) is used only by cw_preview_isolation. Residue search for sibling-task vocabulary (sign/login/password/admin/role/candidate/recruit/HireOps/ticket/cart/invoice/customer/tenant/seed users/demo) across app_context, all prompts and all judge.toml criteria returned only the 'Accounts: None' line; no CHANGE_ME placeholders remain. Counterexample attempts: (1) a conforming app titled e.g. 'JS Playground' instead of 'Colderwater' - no criterion grades the name, so it is not failed; (2) a broken app with no Undo/Redo buttons is caught by cw_undo_redo_availability, and the prompts' screen list does not credit absent controls. No inaccurate or foreign description was found.
notes: P3 note: the product name 'Colderwater' appears in every prompt and app_context.md:3 but not in the public instruction.md or /instructions notes, so a submitted app will normally carry a different name. Nothing grades the name and every prompt pins the URL, so this is not a defect; renaming to 'the playground' would remove any judge confusion.

Out of this row's scope, recorded for the owner: app_context.md:19-20 and cw_newer_run_supersedes rely on a Playwright 'code runner' (page.keyboard/page.mouse) in @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile:19). Whether that tool is exposed to the configured judge on these bytes is not measured; the evidence index states no configured judge run exists for these bytes. That is a tool-feasibility/runtime question for other rows, not a prompt-accuracy defect.
